chat_heads.setting.enabled.tooltip: Draw the sender's player head in the chat.
chat_heads.setting.sender_detection.tool: How the sender is found: from the packet's sender UUID, by matching a known player name in the text, both, or not at all.
chat_heads.setting.system_messages.toolt: Let the name heuristics put heads on lines that are not player chat (join, death and similar messages).
chat_heads.setting.offset_text.tooltip: Shift lines that draw no head so the text columns still line up.
chat_heads.setting.head_shadow.tooltip: Draw a dark copy of the head a pixel down-right, like the text's drop shadow.
